Mister Valdes saved my life.{1a}No, words that ordinary don't cover it...
Anyway, if not for him, I wouldn't be who
I am now.{1a}Plenty of folks in the Coffin of Kars
owe him their lives, and I'm no exception.
He saved mine ten times at least.{1a}When a mistake of mine got two
comrades killed and I'd lost the will to
live, he's the one who got me back on
my feet.{1a}{0c:5218202b501000}From that man I learned that if you've
got the will, you can start your life over
as many times as you want.{0c:fe}
